CookiesPage.title: Cookie Policy
CookiesPage.intro: This website uses cookies to ensure its proper functioning and to provide a better browsing experience. This policy explains what cookies are, which ones we use, and how you can manage them.
CookiesPage.s1Text: Cookies are small text files stored on your device (computer, tablet or smartphone) when you visit a website. They allow the site to remember your preferences and actions so you do not have to re-enter them.
CookiesPage.s2Intro: We use only strictly necessary cookies for the website to function. We do not use advertising, tracking or third-party behavioural analysis cookies.
CookiesPage.s2Cookie1Purpose: Authentication of partner professionals in the private area.
CookiesPage.s2Cookie1Duration: Duration: session (deleted when the browser is closed).
CookiesPage.s2Cookie3Purpose: Records your decision to accept or reject cookies.
CookiesPage.s2Cookie4Purpose: Temporary access to the professional presentation after submitting the professional form. HttpOnly cookie, not accessible to scripts.
CookiesPage.s2Note: These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be disabled without affecting usability. They are not used for advertising purposes.
CookiesPage.s3Text: You can control and delete cookies through your browser settings. Most browsers allow you to block or delete all or specific cookies. Please note that disabling essential cookies may affect website functionality.
CookiesPage.s3Links: To learn how to manage cookies in your browser, visit:
CookiesPage.s4Text: We may update this Cookie Policy periodically to reflect changes in the technologies used or legal requirements. The date of the last update is shown at the top of this page.
CookiesPage.s5Text: If you have any questions about the use of cookies on this website, please contact us:

PrivacidadePage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacidadePage.intro: Sun BioTan® is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. This Privacy Policy informs you about the data we collect, how we process it and the rights you have, in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR — EU Regulation 2016/679).
PrivacidadePage.s1Text: The controller of your personal data is:
PrivacidadePage.s2Intro: We collect personal data in the following situations:
PrivacidadePage.s2Item1Text: Name, email address, phone number and message. Used exclusively to respond to your enquiry.
PrivacidadePage.s2Item2Text: Full name, business name, city, phone, email address and optional message. Used to evaluate your application as a Sun BioTan® partner.
PrivacidadePage.s2Item5Text: Name, centre name, town/city, phone, email address, type of business, the centre’s website or Instagram, language and your IP address converted into an irreversible code (hash). Used to respond to your request, give you temporary access to the professional presentation and notify our team internally by email and through a messaging service. If you authorise it, your email is also used to send you Sun BioTan® news and offers.
PrivacidadePage.s2Item3Text: Our Centres Map may request access to your geographic location to display the nearest Sun BioTan® centres. This information is processed exclusively in your browser and is NOT transmitted, stored or shared with our servers. Permission is granted or denied through your browser and can be revoked at any time in your device settings.
PrivacidadePage.s3Item1: Responding to contact requests: performance of pre-contractual measures or legitimate interest [Art. 6(1)(b) and (f) GDPR].
PrivacidadePage.s3Item2: Processing professional applications: performance of pre-contractual measures [Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR].
PrivacidadePage.s3Item5: Professional form (responding to your request, access to the presentation and internal notification): taking steps at your request prior to entering into a contract [Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR].
PrivacidadePage.s3Item6: Commercial communications by email (news and offers): consent, which you can withdraw at any time by writing to info@sunbiotan.pt [Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR].
PrivacidadePage.s3Item3: Essential cookies: legitimate interest to ensure the technical functioning of the website [Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR].
PrivacidadePage.s3Item4: Geolocation: explicit consent of the user through the browser [Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR].
PrivacidadePage.s4Item1: Contact form data: retained for 12 months.
PrivacidadePage.s4Item2: Professional application data: retained for 24 months or until a final decision is made.
PrivacidadePage.s4Item4: Professional form data: retained for 24 months. The email used for commercial communications is retained until you withdraw your consent.
PrivacidadePage.s4Item3: Partner area access data: for the duration of the contractual relationship and 5 years thereafter.
PrivacidadePage.s5Intro: Under the GDPR, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:
PrivacidadePage.s5Right1: Right of access: obtain confirmation as to whether we process your data and access to it.
PrivacidadePage.s5Right2: Right to rectification: request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data.
PrivacidadePage.s5Right3: Right to erasure: request deletion of your data in cases provided for by law.
PrivacidadePage.s5Right4: Right to data portability: receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format.
PrivacidadePage.s5Right5: Right to restriction: request the suspension of processing in certain circumstances.
PrivacidadePage.s5Right6: Right to object: object to processing based on legitimate interest.
PrivacidadePage.s5HowTo: To exercise any of these rights, contact us at info@sunbiotan.pt. We will respond within 30 days.
PrivacidadePage.s6Text: Personal data is processed and stored within the European Union. Our cloud infrastructure provider (Supabase) maintains data on servers located in the European Union, in compliance with the GDPR.
PrivacidadePage.s7Text: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically to reflect legal or operational changes. The date of the last update is shown at the top of this page. We recommend you review it regularly.
PrivacidadePage.s8Text: For any questions related to privacy and data protection, please contact us:
PrivacidadePage.s8CNPDText: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the competent supervisory authority in Portugal:
PrivacidadePage.s8CNPDName: Comissão Nacional de Proteção de Dados (CNPD)

Hero.subtitle: For over a decade, Sun BioTan® has cared for your skin with a professional treatment that delivers a radiant, even and long-lasting tan with a natural-looking result.

FormulaStrip.text: Professional formula with naturally derived ingredients, developed and manufactured in Portugal.

TrueTreatment.title: More than a tan. A professional beauty experience.
TrueTreatment.text: Available exclusively at Authorised Centres, the Sun BioTan® treatment is carried out by professionals trained in the brand's application system. A protocol designed to deliver an even, luminous result adapted to your skin tone, without UV exposure.

About.headline: A tan that enhances your skin.
About.headlineItalic: An experience that enhances how you feel.
About.p1: SUN is a professional formula developed to deliver a radiant, even and long-lasting tan, with no need for UV exposure. Its microdiffusion application spreads the product smoothly and evenly, creating a quick, comfortable and carefully crafted experience.
About.p2: The result is visible right after application and builds progressively over the following hours, reaching its ideal point the next day. The formula helps keep the skin hydrated, soft and luminous, for an elegant tan that lasts, on average, 7 to 9 days.
About.p3: More than a simple aesthetic result, SUN turns tanning into a true professional beauty and skincare ritual.

Occasions.title: There are special moments. And all the other days when we simply want to feel better.
Occasions.closing: Because feeling good in your own skin shouldn't depend on the season.

profit.label: Full-body treatments per litre, on average
Revenue per litre, at €30 to €40 per application
Per hour of actual work (10 to 15 min per application)

claims.profitExample: Each litre yields 20 to 25 full-body treatments on average. At €30 to €40 per application, revenue can reach ~€1,000 per litre. As each application takes 10 to 15 minutes, each hour of actual work represents ~€120 to ~€210.
claims.profitNote: Indicative figures. They vary with the region, the centre’s positioning and the operator’s experience.

faq.q: How do training and start-up work?
faq.a: Hands-on training takes place at your centre on delivery, with a practical demonstration, use of the equipment, skin preparation and aftercare. Afterwards, the team continues to provide technical and commercial support.

faq.q: Can I buy just the product for another machine?
faq.a: New centres start with the complete Sun BioTan® system: equipment, product, protocol and training. Refills are intended for centres working with our system.

faq.q: What care and space conditions are needed?
faq.a: Space preparation, ventilation and cleaning are assessed with you before you start. The protocol includes the aftercare to pass on to clients, such as avoiding showers and sweating for about 5 to 6 hours after the application.
